tooltips.code: Short name the edge node knows the camera by (a-z, 0-9, _ -). For example entry1.
tooltips.post: Which bay the camera belongs to (optional).
tooltips.edgeNode: The edge node that collects this camera's events and frames.
tooltips.streamName: Only the name of the go2rtc/Frigate stream — no address, no login.
tooltips.secretInput: Camera password for the node. Write-only: after saving it is shown nowhere and never returned by the API.

labels.snapshotWaiting: Waiting for a frame from the node…
labels.liveHint: Access lasts 5 minutes and is written to the access journal.
labels.liveNoStream: No stream name is set for this camera.
